# RateMyHusky

> Northeastern University professor & course reviews and ratings, aggregating student reviews, RateMyProfessors, and Reddit.

RateMyHusky is a free ratings and review site for Northeastern University, covering
roughly 9,300 professors and thousands of courses. Ratings and reviews are aggregated
from student reviews, RateMyProfessors, and Reddit discussions, then combined
into a single profile per professor and per course. Pages are served as crawler-readable
static HTML, and data is refreshed regularly.

## Browse

- [All professor ratings](https://ratemyhusky.com/professors)
- [All course reviews](https://ratemyhusky.com/courses)
- [Departments by professor ratings](https://ratemyhusky.com/departments)
- [Full URL list](https://ratemyhusky.com/sitemap.xml)

## Page formats

- Professor pages (`/professors/<slug>`) show a professor's overall rating, difficulty,
  would-take-again percentage, and reviews aggregated from students, RateMyProfessors,
  and Reddit.
- Course pages (`/courses/<code>`) show a course's overall rating, difficulty, and a
  comparison of instructors who have taught it.
